principle: Language and names are persistent systems, not independent random strings generated at each encounter.
generation_order: resolve language family and sound/structure profile
generate individual names from culture-specific naming patterns
rules: Names generated from the same language/culture should exhibit recognizable internal consistency without becoming repetitive.
A Starfleet provisional designation may exist before a self-name is known.
Self-name, translated name and Federation exonym are separate fields.
Do not reveal a civilization's self-name before plausible linguistic/contact evidence.
Writing and spoken language are distinct knowledge layers.
Generated names persist after first materialization.
Language profile does not determine culture/personality.
